name: arm-alliance
description: Helps Codex set up and operate the focused Raspberry Pi and ESP32 desk-arm stack with bounded planning and current telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and use a four-axis desk arm.
interface.longDescription: Guides a co-arm checkout from source validation through simulation and commissioning, then connects Codex to an explicitly configured Raspberry Pi ARM gateway without bundling credentials, runtime state, or machine-specific paths.
defaultPrompt: Help me validate and set up co-arm from this checkout.
Start the co-arm Isaac Sim stack and attach the dashboard.
Read the current arm state and show its 2D scene.
